title: Atomic Recipe Crafting
description: Implement crafting that validates all ingredients and capacity rules before modifying the inventory.
requirements: Recipes must support several ingredient types and quantities.
A failed validation must not modify inventory state.
Ingredients must be removed only after every check succeeds.
The result must identify each missing requirement.
Recipe definitions must remain separate from runtime crafting logic.
constraint: Avoid inheritance for the main design; prefer composition and small interfaces.
stretchGoal: Add profiling counters for the operations most likely to become expensive.
